categories.name: Frames
categories.description: A frame sits around your avatar everywhere it appears. Each preview shows it on your own picture.

categories.name: Name colours
categories.description: Show your username in a colour of your own across the forum.

categories.name: Name icons
categories.description: A small icon next to your username across the forum. You wear one at a time, before or after your name.

categories.name: Thread covers
categories.description: A thread cover is a photo for one of your own threads. Covers are used up: each one goes on a single thread.

categories.name: Boosts
categories.description: Boosts are used up: each one highlights or bumps one of your own threads for a limited time.

categories.name: Permissions
categories.description: Permissions unlock features for your account, such as a signature or a profile cover. Most are bought once and kept, and some also come with a rank.

categories.name: Ranks
categories.description: A rank is bought once with credits. Upgrading from a lower rank costs the difference.

items.name: Summit thread cover
items.description: Snow-covered ridges below a high peak. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Skyline thread cover
items.description: A lit bridge and a city skyline at night, in black and white. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Bokeh thread cover
items.description: Soft, out-of-focus lights in warm colours. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Forest bay thread cover
items.description: Treetops in front of a blue bay and distant hills. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Sunset field thread cover
items.description: A meadow and a row of trees under an orange sky. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Storm bridge thread cover
items.description: A suspension bridge against heavy evening clouds. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Stage light thread cover
items.description: A lone figure in the haze of the stage lights. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Vinyl thread cover
items.description: A turntable needle on a spinning record. A photo for one of your own threads, used up when you apply it.

items.name: Thread highlight, 3 days
items.description: Make one of your threads stand out in its forum, in the feed and on its opening post for three days.

items.name: Thread highlight, 7 days
items.description: Make one of your threads stand out in its forum, in the feed and on its opening post for a full week.

items.name: Thread bump
items.description: Move one of your threads back to the top of its forum.

items.name: Promote my thread for 24 h
items.description: Feature one of your threads for a full day: it is marked as promoted and shown on the home page, and listed first in Hot while it is among the 10 newest features (an older one is listed only where it ranks). Not refunded if the thread is deleted.

items.name: Signature
items.description: Add a short signature that is shown under your posts.

items.name: Profile cover
items.description: Pick a photo from the gallery as the cover of your profile, your posts and your member card.

items.name: Custom title
items.description: Replace the title under your name with your own text.

items.name: Award showcase slot
items.description: Show one more award next to your name.

items.name: Username change
items.description: Change your username. Each purchase allows one change.

items.name: Ember
items.description: Unlocks: rank badge next to your name; exclusive name colour; exclusive rank award; custom member title; signature under your posts.

items.name: Blaze
items.description: Unlocks: rank badge next to your name; exclusive name colour; exclusive rank award; custom member title; signature under your posts; name colours of the ranks below; profile cover photo.

items.name: Inferno
items.description: Unlocks: rank badge next to your name; exclusive name colour; exclusive rank award; custom member title; signature under your posts; name colours of the ranks below; profile cover photo; extra award showcase slot.
